chfn_restrict.description: Fields a regular user may change via chfn(1): 'f' (full name), 'r' (room), 'w' (work phone), 'h' (home phone). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#CHFN_RESTRICT		rwh).

create_home.description: CREATE_HOME (as documented in the shipped file).

default_home.description: DEFAULT_HOME (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#DEFAULT_HOME	yes).

encrypt_method.description: Password hashing algorithm (YESCRYPT, BCRYPT, SHA512, SHA256, MD5, or DES). YESCRYPT recommended.

env_path.description: ENV_PATH (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#ENV_PATH	PATH=/bin:/usr/bin).

env_supath.description: ENV_SUPATH (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#ENV_SUPATH	PATH=/sbin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin).

fail_delay.description: FAIL_DELAY (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#FAIL_DELAY		3).

force_shadow.description: FORCE_SHADOW (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#FORCE_SHADOW    yes).

gid_min.description: First regular group GID (non-system groups). System groups get GIDs below this.

hmac_crypto_algo.description: HMAC_CRYPTO_ALGO (as documented in the shipped file).

home_mode.description: HOME_MODE (as documented in the shipped file).

log_unkfail_enab.description: LOG_UNKFAIL_ENAB (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#LOG_UNKFAIL_ENAB	no).

login_retries.description: Maximum number of login retries before aborting. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#LOGIN_RETRIES		3).

login_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) allowed for login. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#LOGIN_TIMEOUT		60).

mail_dir.description: Directory where user mailboxes are stored.

mail_file.description: MAIL_FILE (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#MAIL_FILE	.mail).

max_members_per_group.description: MAX_MEMBERS_PER_GROUP (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#MAX_MEMBERS_PER_GROUP	0).

pass_max_days.description: Maximum number of days a password may be used before it must be changed. Set to 0 to disable expiration.

pass_min_days.description: Minimum number of days between password changes. Prevents immediate password re-use.

pass_warn_age.description: Number of days before password expiration to warn the user.

sha_crypt_max_rounds.description: SHA_CRYPT_MAX_ROUNDS (as documented in the shipped file).

sub_gid_count.description: Number of subordinate GIDs per user.

sub_gid_max.description: Last subordinate GID for user namespace.

sub_gid_min.description: First subordinate GID for user namespace.

sub_uid_count.description: Number of subordinate UIDs per user.

sub_uid_max.description: Last subordinate UID for user namespace.

sub_uid_min.description: First subordinate UID for user namespace.

sys_gid_max.description: SYS_GID_MAX (as documented in the shipped file).

sys_gid_min.description: SYS_GID_MIN (as documented in the shipped file).

sys_uid_max.description: SYS_UID_MAX (as documented in the shipped file).

sys_uid_min.description: SYS_UID_MIN (as documented in the shipped file).

syslog_sg_enab.description: SYSLOG_SG_ENAB (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#SYSLOG_SG_ENAB		yes).

uid_max.description: Last regular user UID. User IDs beyond this may be reserved for special uses.

uid_min.description: First regular user UID (non-system accounts). System accounts get UIDs below this.

umask.description: UMASK (as documented in the shipped file).

userdel_cmd.description: USERDEL_CMD (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#USERDEL_CMD	/usr/sbin/userdel_local).

usergroups_enab.description: If true, creates a group for the user with the same name as the user account.
